name: Tech-Lead Execute — plan, execute, verify, close
description: Wraps the tech-lead card. plan (decompose spec to tasks via to-tickets, dispatch via kanban_chains) → verify (adversarial-review on integrated work) → close. The plan node blocks on kanban_chains until all dev cards finish — verify fires at the correct time.

nodes.body_template:
## Implementation Planning

**Spec card:** ${trigger.card_id}
**Title:** ${trigger.title}

You are the tech-lead. The PO has already written the spec — DO NOT grill the user. Your job is implementation planning.

### Phase 1: Discover

Read the spec card body for full requirements. Read the codebase: AGENTS.md, existing tests, conventions, structure. Understand what exists today.

### Phase 2: Plan (autonomous decomposition)

Load your `to-tickets` skill. Decompose the spec into atomic tasks. For each task:
- Title (short, actionable)
- Acceptance criteria (checklist of testable assertions)
- Dependencies (which tasks must complete before this one)
- Sizing (small/medium/large)

### Phase 3: Dispatch via kanban_chains (CRITICAL)

Call `kanban_chains` to dispatch ALL tasks. This STRUCTURALLY BLOCKS your card until all dev cards reach done.

- One chain per task (if tasks have serial dependencies, put them in the SAME chain as sequential steps)
- Each chain step: {assignee: "developer", title: "[task] <title>", body: "<acceptance criteria + constraints>"}
- Parallel chains for independent tasks
- Your card auto-blocks. Do NOT call kanban_complete. Do NOT create cards via kanban_create.
- The system will auto-promote you when ALL chains finish.

After auto-promotion: read the verifier completion summaries. If ALL PASS → kanban_complete with the plan metadata. If any FAIL → check for fix chains created by the verifier.

NO human approval needed. NO beads. Fully autonomous.

**Completion metadata:**
```
{plan_complete: true, task_count: N, task_ids: ["t_xxx", ...], sizing_summary: "small:N medium:N large:N"}
```

## Overall Verification — integrated feature

**Spec card:** ${trigger.card_id}
**Plan:** ${nodes.plan.output.task_count} tasks completed

This is OVERALL verification — not per-task. All developer cards are complete and their work is merged. Your job:

1. **Integration check**: do all tasks work TOGETHER? No conflicts, no missing wiring.
2. **Spec compliance**: does the complete implementation satisfy the ORIGINAL spec from ${trigger.card_id}?
3. **Acceptance criteria**: verify EVERY AC from the plan against the integrated code.
4. **Code review**: run adversarial-review on the complete diff (all tasks combined).
5. **Edge cases**: falsify the integrated feature — try to break it.

Load your `adversarial-review` skill.

**Verdict routing:**
- PASS (zero findings): merge to main, complete with verdict=PASS
- FAIL: create fix cards for developers, complete with verdict=FAIL
- ESCALATE (iter >= 3 or spec gap): complete with verdict=ESCALATE

**Completion metadata:**
```
{verdict: "PASS"|"FAIL"|"ESCALATE", findings_count: N, acs_verified: N, acs_total: N}
```

## Close — wrap up the sprint

**Spec card:** ${trigger.card_id}
**Verdict:** ${nodes.verify.output.verdict}

All tasks are complete. The verifier has run overall verification.

### If PASS:
- Write journal entry (what worked, what didn't)
- Run reflection (what to learn)
- Complete this card with verdict=merged

### If ESCALATE:
- Read the verifier's findings
- Classify: defect-bug (route to debugger) / contract-gap (re-contract) / harness-ceiling (switch model) / wrong-slice (abandon)
- Take action based on classification
- Complete with verdict=escalated

**Completion metadata:**
```
{verdict: "merged"|"escalated", tasks_planned: N, tasks_completed: N, escalate_reason: ""}
```
